title: Vedic Hymns, Part II: Hymns to Agni
altTitles: Sacred Books of the East, vol. 46
dateDisplay: Hymns composed c. 1500–1000 BCE; translation published 1897
attributionNote: The hymns are anonymous. The selection, translation and notes are Hermann Oldenberg's, continuing Max Müller's Vedic Hymns for the Sacred Books of the East.
description: The second volume of Vedic Hymns translates the Rigvedic hymns to Agni, the priest of the sacrifice and the fire that carries the offering. Oldenberg's selection follows the god through the first book and beyond — the kindling and the invitation, the oblation, the household fire, the funeral pyre — with a philological introduction and notes on the text.
historicalContext: Hermann Oldenberg (1854–1920) was one of the leading Vedic and Buddhist scholars of his generation, known for his work on the Rigveda, the Pali canon and Vedic religion. He completed the Vedic Hymns volume in 1897 as SBE 46.
availabilityNote: Complete as published: the hymns to Agni with translation and notes, streamed from the Internet Sacred Text Archive at read time, one hymn per chapter. The volume's appendices, indexes and corrigenda are not part of the work.
